title: Private Morning Sail in San Diego up to 12 guests $975
includes: Bareboat Charter Captain Fee: $125 (included in total booking price)
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This private morning sail is a great way to start the day. Mornings are best to go see San Diego's wildlife because there is little wind and few waves, allowing us to easily cross over to Point Loma. The bay will most likely have a calm gentle surface, allowing us to go with our motor with minimal leaning.

Sea Monkey Adventures is a Family oriented sailing tour that places quality family time in its core mission. We aim to help families set aside time to prioritize time together, where they can talk, laugh, catch up with each other and create lasting memories.
